messages:
carla: FYI a customer (tenant: peloton-app) is seeing a lot of 429s and long tail latency after yesterday's capacity reshuffle. They hit dedicated pool D-P40-07.
carla: Error sample from prod: `429: rate_exceeded` and some requests show >2s tail latency even for short prompts. Repro steps they gave: simple generate call, 1.2k tokens total, no streaming.
ben: Thanks, digging in. Do we have quick mapping from tenant -> pool routing rules for that pool? suspect mis-routed quota.
jordan: I can pull routing. Quick note: we rolled a routing rule overwrite at 02:10 UTC that moved several tenants onto D-P40-07 for warmup. Could be related.
carla: Customer says they were stable overnight then started seeing issues ~03:00 UTC. They switched to a backup key and still got 429s.
lee: Can you paste the request headers (sanitized)? curious if the tenant header is being rewritten.
carla: Paste (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-tenant-id: tenant-peloton
x-model: redwood-ggml-13b
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
```
carla: They also included an `x-caller-id` that matches internal svc account.
ben: I see two likely causes: 1) per-tenant rate profile accidentally assigned from the sharded config; 2) quota window denom mismatch (minutes vs hours) after the routing rewrite.
jordan: Pulling rate profile for tenant-peloton... got it: profile shows `ceil: 600` with denom `HOUR`, but pool-level override for D-P40-07 has a `DEFAULT` mapping of `DENOM=MINUTE` for warmup tenants.
jordan: That mismatch would make hourly ceilings interpreted per-minute -> 600 req/min effectively 36k/hr spike? Wait inverse: if system expects HOUR but denom set to MINUTE, it could throttle prematurely. Need to confirm code path.
lee: @oncall-bot can you show recent deploys touching routing/rateconfig?
oncall-bot: Deploys since 2024-06-10: infra/routing-service v1.14.3 @ 02:07 UTC, api/gateway v2.8.0 @ 02:09 UTC. No subsequent rollbacks.
ben: OK. @jordan can you run a quick sim of the quota evaluation for tenant-peloton under pool override? i.e., feed sample requests and show token counters.
jordan: Running local sim... attaching mini log snippet:
```
[sim] tenant=tenant-peloton pool=D-P40-07 request_id=abc123 tokens=45 denom_override=MINUTE
[sim] computed_unit = ceil(600) * denom_factor(MINUTE->60?) => mismatched interpretation => throttle=true
```
jordan: TL;DR: routing override is applying a denom conversion earlier than intended, so ratechecker treats the 600 as per-minute.
carla: Customer confirmed they have 450 req/min spikes during their job-run windows. That explains the 429s.
ben: Mitigation options: 1) temporary remove denom override for D-P40-07, 2) bump tenant's ceiling on that pool, 3) route tenant to original pool. Which is fastest?
lee: Easiest immediate: remove the pool-level denom override. I'll file a quick rollback. If we do that we should see 429 drop within 60s for in-flight counters.
carla: Customer is fine with immediate mitigation. Please coordinate and message them.
lee: Rolling back routing-service config now (no code change, config flag).
lee: Rollback complete @ 03:25 UTC. health checks green.
ben: Observability: I see 429s drop by ~95% at ~03:27 UTC. Tail latency also normalizing.
carla: Customer confirms reduced 429s and improved latency. They still want a postmortem and permanent fix.
jordan: Root cause summary: a config overwrite introduced at 02:10 UTC set pool-level denom to MINUTE for warmup tenants; the quota evaluator used tenant profile's numeric ceiling without converting denom, resulting in effective per-minute enforcement. Racey deploy and partially-applied overrides caused misassignment.
ben: Action items: 1) add automated unit test for denom conversions in quota evaluator (assigned jordan), 2) add deploy-time validation to block mismatched denom overrides (assigned lee), 3) notify customer with timeline and credits (carla).
carla: I'll draft customer comms. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
